title: Check Overall System AGV Status popup for AGVs with destination errors
summary: Use the live RMS / fleet status UI popup titled “Overall System AGV Status” to identify which AGVs currently have errors and review their Destination and Errors details. The popup shows a top section for all AGVs and a bottom section filtered to only AGVs with errors.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly determine which AGVs have active errors related to destination/error conditions and view their Destination and Errors details in the RMS fleet status UI.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and verify the “Overall System AGV Status” popup fields and error-filtered list; capture the AGV IDs and their Destination/Errors values.

access_required: Access to RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui)

visual_references.description: Frame showing the “Overall System AGV Status” popup with top section (all AGVs: ID, Status, Destination, Errors) and bottom section (only AGVs with errors with additional detail).

steps.title: Open the RMS “Overall System AGV Status” popup
steps.purpose: Get to the correct RMS popup that contains the AGV ID, Status, Destination, and Errors fields and the error-filtered bottom section.
steps.instruction: In the RMS / fleet status UI (rms_ui), navigate to the popup/screen titled “Overall System AGV Status”.
steps.expected_result: The “Overall System AGV Status” popup is displayed.
steps.healthy_condition: The popup title “Overall System AGV Status” is visible and the popup is rendered with both top and bottom sections.
steps.failure_condition: The popup does not display the “Overall System AGV Status” title or does not render the expected popup content.

actions.label: Verify popup title
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and navigate to the popup/screen titled “Overall System AGV Status”.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Popup “Overall System AGV Status” shows detailed info for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors); bottom section shows only AGVs with errors with additional detail.

steps.title: Confirm top section fields for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors)
steps.purpose: Ensure the popup is showing the required columns/fields so you can interpret which AGVs have errors.
steps.instruction: In the “Overall System AGV Status” popup, check the top section table/list to confirm it includes fields/columns for ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.
steps.expected_result: The top section displays the fields/columns “ID”, “Status”, “Destination”, and “Errors”.
steps.healthy_condition: The top section shows a detailed table/list for all AGVs with visible column headers/fields: ID, Status, Destination, Errors.
steps.failure_condition: The popup top section is missing one or more expected fields/columns (ID/Status/Destination/Errors).

actions.label: Check column headers
actions.exact_action: In the top section, confirm the popup shows a detailed table/list for all AGVs with columns/fields for ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the popup fails to display the expected fields (ID/Status/Destination/Errors).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Detailed info for all AGVs — ID, Status, Destination, and Errors.

steps.title: Confirm bottom section is filtered to AGVs with errors
steps.purpose: Verify the error-only filtering behavior so you can trust the bottom list for error AGVs.
steps.instruction: In the “Overall System AGV Status” popup, check the bottom section to confirm it lists only AGVs with errors and includes additional error/destination detail for those AGVs.
steps.expected_result: The bottom section lists only AGVs with errors (error cases) and shows additional detail for those error AGVs.
steps.healthy_condition: The bottom section contains only error AGVs and additional detail is present for those error cases.
steps.failure_condition: The bottom section is empty when the top section indicates any AGV has a non-empty Errors value, or the bottom section does not behave as an error-only list.

actions.label: Verify error-only filtering
actions.exact_action: In the bottom section, confirm only AGVs with errors appear and that additional detail is shown for those error AGVs.

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the bottom section is empty while the top section indicates any AGV has a non-empty Errors value.
Escalate if the bottom section does not behave as described (should show only AGVs with errors).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Bottom section: Only AGVs with errors, with additional detail will appear.

steps.title: Record AGV IDs and their Destination/Errors from the error-only bottom section
steps.purpose: Capture the specific AGVs currently showing errors and the associated Destination and Errors details for follow-up troubleshooting/escalation.
steps.instruction: For each AGV listed in the bottom (error-only) section, record/verify the AGV ID and the associated Destination and Errors details displayed in the popup.
steps.expected_result: You have a list of AGV IDs from the bottom section along with their displayed Destination and Errors values.
steps.healthy_condition: Each bottom-section row corresponds to an error case and includes the AGV ID plus Destination and Errors details.
steps.failure_condition: Bottom-section rows are missing AGV ID or do not show Destination/Errors details needed to identify the error case.

actions.label: Capture error AGV details
actions.exact_action: For each AGV shown in the bottom (error-only) section, record/verify the AGV ID and the associated Destination and Errors details displayed in the popup.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Top section shows ID, Status, Destination, Errors; bottom section shows only AGVs with errors with additional detail.

steps.title: Escalate if popup fields are missing or error-only list behavior is inconsistent
steps.purpose: Ensure you stop and escalate when the UI does not match the expected behavior, preventing incorrect conclusions.
steps.instruction: If the popup does not show the expected “Overall System AGV Status” title/fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors) or if the bottom section does not correctly show only AGVs with errors, stop and escalate.
steps.expected_result: Escalation is initiated when UI evidence is inconsistent with expected fields or filtering behavior.
steps.healthy_condition: No escalation is required because the popup title/fields are present and the bottom section correctly reflects error-only AGVs.
steps.failure_condition: UI evidence is inconsistent (missing fields or incorrect bottom-section filtering).

actions.label: Escalate
actions.exact_action: Stop and escalate if the bottom section is empty while the top section indicates any AGV has a non-empty Errors value, or if the popup fails to display the expected fields (ID/Status/Destination/Errors).

stop_or_escalate_if: Escalate if the popup does not show the expected “Overall System AGV Status” title/fields (ID, Status, Destination, Errors).
Escalate if the bottom section does not behave as described (should show only AGVs with errors).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Popup “Overall System AGV Status” shows detailed info for all AGVs (ID, Status, Destination, Errors); bottom section shows only AGVs with errors with additional detail.

success_criteria: The “Overall System AGV Status” popup displays the expected fields: ID, Status, Destination, Errors in the top section.
The bottom section lists only AGVs with errors and shows additional detail for those error AGVs.
For each AGV in the bottom (error-only) section, the AGV ID and its Destination and Errors values are captured.
healthy_conditions: Top section shows all AGVs with visible fields/columns: ID, Status, Destination, Errors.
Bottom section is non-empty when the top section shows at least one AGV with a non-empty Errors value.
Bottom section contains only AGVs with errors and includes additional detail for those error cases.
failure_conditions: Popup fails to display expected fields (ID/Status/Destination/Errors).
Bottom section is empty while the top section indicates any AGV has a non-empty Errors value.
Bottom section does not behave as an error-only list.
escalation_guidance: Escalate when the popup UI does not match expected title/fields or when the bottom section filtering behavior is inconsistent with the top section Errors values.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: The “Overall System AGV Status” popup showing: (1) top section with columns/fields ID, Status, Destination, Errors for all AGVs; (2) bottom section listing only AGVs with errors with additional detail.
